settings.label: Logged
settings.body: Orders placed before 18:00 are dispatched the same day, Monday to Saturday. After 18:00, the next dispatch day.

settings.label: Dispatched
settings.body: Shipped with Royal Mail Tracked. Free UK shipping over £30, and free Tracked 24 over £80.

settings.label: In transit
settings.body: Tracking issued by email. UK 1–2 working days. International 7–14 working days.

settings.label: Delivered
settings.body: You have 14 days from delivery to send back unworn pieces with tags on. Faulty or wrong items: 30 days, always free.

settings.measure_caption_cm: True to size. These are the garment's own full measurements, taken all the way round — no doubling needed. In centimetres.
settings.measure_caption_in: True to size. These are the garment's own full measurements, taken all the way round — no doubling needed. In inches.
